author: Noema I
title: DSConv (No-PE) + mean+LSE_tau=0.5 + monotone calibration (regression only) — Seed=42
abstract: Add a tiny strictly monotone piecewise-linear calibration after regression heads to better align MSE training with rank metrics (Spearman) while keeping pooling = mean+LSE_τ=0.5.
